items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) practiced Friday, improved steadily; no WR elevated, pushing to play with optimism barring setback. Schefter: flak jacket if plays.
items.why: Rib injury improved more than anticipated.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 1, downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; targets shift to Andrews/Bateman/others.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Mark Andrews and Ravens WRs.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday; elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White.
items.implication: Michael Mayer primary beneficiary if out.
items.opportunity: Mayer TE volume spike; Myarick elevation.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT vs Patriots with foot injury.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for DK Metcalf and others.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins ruled OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with hamstring.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for Texans pass-catchers.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring), listed Q, is expected to play at Baltimore.
Rams listed WR Puka Nacua questionable for MNF vs Giants (hip/groin soreness); Jordan Whittington doubtful (quad). No practice.
items.why: Hip injury + groin soreness post-Thursday practice; different from camp. Pregame decision.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; risk if no backup.
items.opportunity: If out, TEs Ferguson/Parkinson + Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected to play vs Texans.
items.why: Back soreness; Burrow said missing would be ridiculous; full practice Friday.

items.text: ETR Cheap WR Volume: Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris project 5+ targets; large roles if Ladd McConkey out in Raiders matchup (QJ already above 5 regardless).
items.why: Week 1 target shares post-McConkey exit; friendly matchup.
items.opportunity: QJ/Harris volume spike if McConkey inactive.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% target share; Indy gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score (tied Bijan), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3/4 last.
Berry LOVES Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util, 26% targets, all RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC; out-routed Gainwell.
Berry LOVES Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% targets from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; Bears soft vs WRs.
Berry LOVES DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% targets, 13.7 aDOT W1; TEN allowed high catch/YPR; soft vs WRs.
Berry HATES Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes W1, air-dependent; Kamara expected back squeezes role; underdog script.
Berry HATES Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: Only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ; SEA tough vs WRs.
Berry HATES Brian Thomas Jr. @ DEN: DEN tough on perimeter/deep; limited practice (shoulder).
Berry LOVES Dak Prescott vs WAS: Home PPG strong; WAS torched W1; high implied total/shootout potential.
items.why: Smash spot vs weak pass D.
